title: Anomalous objects seen by a Navy acoustic intelligence ship off Japan

tellings.quote: he was an acoustic specialist, retired as a captain, was on one of the Navy's acoustic intelligence ships off Japan. In two cases, they also observed these anomalous objects

plain: A Navy ship that gathered intelligence by listening underwater, operating off Japan, observed unexplained objects on two occasions. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells Michels he heard this from an acoustic specialist who served aboard and retired as a captain; Gallaudet does not name him. If true, it would add the Navy's own listening ships to the record of strange objects at sea.
